New T-C1 cases (j) scoped-only row unchanged/no tenant_wide row, (k), (l); T-B8. B2 (CDV): FK scope_node_id->scope_node_paths DEFERRED to stage 2 #2535 (item S2-1); 1a keeps column, CHECK and scope_node_id index; T-M3(e) now pins absence of FK; T-N1 adds test/letflow/scope_node_paths/migration_test.exs; section 1.6 updated. Migration up/0 takes lock A as its FIRST execute (lock_tenant_admins_in_migration!/1). Advisories: run_tenant_error = :gap_remains | {:audit_failed, term()}, tenant_report / dry_run_tenant_report / report (with skipped) types named (CDV A2, T-B4, T-B7); precedent cite :50-77 (CDV A3); Backfill.run/1 skips and reports missing-schema registrations and continues (SEC, T-B6). OQ-3 resolved: no rescue in 1a, T-W8 R2 assert_raise Postgrex.Error then group_id and row on A. OQ-4: ORCH asks letflow-2 to file. New section 10 'For 1b and stage 2': 1b-1 allowed?/3 never consults grants for platform scope (test); 1b-2 the three D1 tenant_wide-creating binding writes (routing->platform, nil->P enforced, sync into tenant-wide group); 1b-3 rebind_role rescue; S2-1 FK. --- r0 SUMMARY: Design written for REQ-497 PR 1a.MIGRATION priv/repo/migrations/20261015025331_create_role_scope_grants.exs (Letflow.Repo.Migrations.CreateRoleScopeGrants, version 20_261_015_025_331; checked against origin/main latest 20261014100002, open PR #2565's 20261014000002, no #2552 branch pushed, no test/lib literal collision). up/0 + down/0 under the if prefix() guard; public create_objects/1, run_backfill!/1, assert_no_gap!/1. Table role_scope_grants: id uuid, principal_type text CHECK user|group, principal_id uuid (no FK: polymorphic), role text (closed set enforced in changeset, no DB CHECK), scope_node_id text FK scope_node_paths(node_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, tenant_wide boolean NOT NULL no default, timestamps usec. CHECK role_scope_grants_tenant_wide_xor_node; index role_scope_grants_principal_role_idx (principal_type, principal_id, role); partial unique role_scope_grants_tenant_wide_uniq WHERE tenant_wide and role_scope_grants_scoped_uniq WHERE NOT tenant_wide. Backfill inside the migration transaction (Ecto.Migrator runs each migration in repo.transaction in one Task; zero-arity execute/1): tenant admin advisory lock first (same key as every binding writer), frozen INSERT...SELECT one tenant_wide GROUP row per kind=platform_role tenant_role row ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, frozen T9 assert raising with count only, then Letflow.Audit.insert_entry scope.backfill_completed with counts only (source, migration_version, platform_role_bindings, group_rows_inserted, user_rows_inserted 0, process_routing_bindings_skipped, bindings_without_row_after 0) only for a real tenant schema with >0 bindings (new tenants replay before seeding, so they get rows from the seeding writers and no entry; residual Entry-schema replay risk stated). Manifest entry after CreateScopeNodePaths; @expected_tenant_tables + count 52->53 in tenant_fixture_test.exs:324 (only existing test edit, outside AC4's set). CORE: schema Letflow.Identity.RoleScopeGrant; module Letflow.Identity.RoleScopeGrants with reconcile_binding!/3 (single writer entry point, raises outside a transaction, 9-row decision table), ensure_tenant_wide_group_row!/3, remove_group_rows!/3, move_group_rows!/4, delete_group_principal_rows!/2, T9 bindings_without_row/1 and bindings_without_row_count/1, orphan_group_rows/1, user_row_count/1. WRITERS: W1 insert_role role_registry.ex:521 before audit :522; W2 converge_existing_role kind-change :555 and unchanged :550 (ensure); W3 move_role after :709 before :723; W4 ensure_platform_role_binding existing branch :299 (ensure), nil branch via W1; W5 TenantAdminMigration ensure_binding :346/:350 and remove_legacy_binding after :391 before :393; W6 delete_group after delete_all :767 returning {1,_}. All rows are lock rank B after A/R/G and before C per the #2547 proof; no new lock. Membership writers unchanged (no user rows). BACKFILL Letflow.Identity.RoleScopeGrants.Backfill.run/1 and run_tenant/2 (per-tenant transaction under lock_tenant_admins!, inserts exactly the T9 gap, audits only when it inserted, dry_run read-only), mix letflow.backfill_role_scope_grants [--dry-run], release via bin/letflow rpc. TESTS T-M1..T-M6 (incl. migration-level abort via test-support gap migration), T-C1..T-C4, T-W1..T-W14 (rollback R1 forced outer rollback, R2 injected trigger failure, per writer), T-B1..T-B5, T-N1/T-N2. OVERLAP: #2565 append-only manifest/oracle conflict (count 54 after both); #2552 touches token functions only, 1a touches identity.ex only in delete_group; #2564 untouched. OQ-1 PLATFORM_ADMIN gets a tenant_wide row under the binding principal model, 1b must not consult grants for platform scope; OQ-2 direct tenant_role fixture inserts make T9 gaps (matters in 1b); OQ-3 rebind_role has no rescue; OQ-4 sole-writer mix check deferred; OQ-5 post-rolling-deploy backfill run.
